PAUL JAMES CASTILLON Former SK Chairnan Barangay Lower T away Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay Dear Mr. Castillon: This has reference to your email dated July 15, 2022 requesting for clarification on the Grant of Barangay Official Eligibility to a former SK Chairperson. The facts, as culled from the documents forwarded to us, are reproduced as follow: 1. You are a former Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Chairperson of Barangay Lower Taway, Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay from 1 July 2018 until your voluntary resignation on IO January 2022; 2. In a letter, you requested for the issuance of certification of service rendered from the DILG Field Officer in the said municipality, as one of the requirements in securing sub-professional eligibility from the • Civil Service Commission (CSC); 3. However, the DILG Field Officer refused to issue the said certification due to your resignation as SK Chairperson as alleged; and 4. Thus, you would like to be clarified if you are qualified to be issued a certification from the DILG municipal office as required by the CSC in securing your sub-professional eligibility. We hold the same position with the NBOO and the DILG Field Officer in denying the issuance of certification of service rendered. Under RA 85241 or an Act Changing the Term of Office of Barangay Officials and Members of the Sangguniang Kabataan from Three (3) Years to Five (5) Years, Amending for the Purpose Section 43 of RA 7196 or the Local Government Code of 1991, the term of barangay officials and members of the sangguniang kabataan shall be for five (5) years. I Sec. 43. Term of office. — (a) The term of office of all elective officials elected effectivity Of this Code shall be three (3) years, starting from noon of June 30. 1992 or such date as may be provided tor by law. except that of elective barangay officials and members of the sangguniang kabataan: Provided, That all local officials first elected during the local elections immediately fonowing the ratification of the 1987 Constitution shall serve until noon ot June 30. 1992. The term of barangay Officials and members of the sangguniang kabataan shall be for five (5) years. which shall begin after the regular election of barangay officials on the second Monday of May 1997: Provided, That the sangguniang Kabataan members who were elected in the May 1996 elections shall serve until the next regular election Of barangay officials. Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

on the other hand, Section 393 (b) (5) of R.A. No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 provides for the entitlement to appropriate civil service eligibility on the basis of the number of years of service to the barangay, pursuant to the rules and regulations issued by the Civil Service Commission. For purposes of emphasis, we cite the pertinent provisions of CSC Memorandum Circular No. 13 S. 2012. dated 2 August 2012 re: Policies on Service Requirement for Grant of Barangay Official Eligibility and Other Related Matters as reference, to wit: (1) The grant of Barangay Official Eligibility (BOE) shall be based strictly on completion of term of office. In no instance shall a barangay official concerned who did not complete his/her term of office for whatever reason; be eligible to avail of the grand of BOE; (2) Completion of term of office shall be defined, as follows: (a) For elected barangay officials - shall refer to the term of office as specified by the prevailing law on term of office of elected barangay officials. Considering that you started as SK Chairperson of Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay on 1 July 2018 and later voluntarily resigned on IO January 2022, you did not complete the five (5)-year term of your office. As expressly provided under the above-mentioned Civil Service rule, you are therefore not entitled to the grant of Barangay Official Eligibility (BOE). Notwithstanding, we would like to emphasize that this opinion is rendered based solely on the facts you have provided this Office and our appreciation of the same. This opinion is without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions. and orders of competent authorities or courts. Finally, this opinion may vary depending on the facts changed or elaborated. We hope to have provided sufficient guidance on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECR TARY: VI OR R.
